item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Change Only the Bottle

turns.text: Turn just the black bottle forest green, still matte. Everything outside the bottle must stay exactly the same, including the table and shadow.

item.tests: Tests tightly masked recolouring, checked by comparing all pixels outside the bottle against the source at matching resolution.

answer_sheet.Target object: The matte black bottle in product-bottle.jpg.
answer_sheet.New appearance: Forest green with the existing matte finish and shading.
answer_sheet.Allowed edit area: Only the bottle itself. Leave the table, background and cast shadow unchanged.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the square composition without cropping or shifting; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The black bottle is now forest green and still looks matte.
The bottle retains its exact silhouette, position and surface details.
The wooden table, background and cast shadow are unchanged.
At matching resolution, comparison outside the bottle mask shows no visible alterations, allowing only encoding differences.
No green spill, editing halo, crop or framing shift is visible.

turns.text: can you change the bottle in this pic

dialog.agent:
Sure, I can do that. One thing first: **What should change in the picture?**

For example, you could give the bottle a new colour or finish, like white, pastel or brushed steel. You could also swap it for a different kind of bottle, like clear glass or a sports bottle with a straw lid. Or you could add a logo or label, and if you do, tell me the exact words you want on it.

The room, table, lighting and camera angle will stay the same unless you want those changed too.
dialog.why: It asks the user what should change in the picture and waits for that answer.
dialog.user: make it forest green, keep it matte. dont touch anything else, table and shadow stay the same

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the green bottle. Magic Hour turned the edit down because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was made and you have no new image yet.

I'd already used the cheapest setting the free plan offers (about 5 credits for one 640px image), so a cheaper retry isn't possible.

To get it made, you can:
- **Add credits:** buy a credit pack or wait for your free credits to refill.
- **Upgrade your plan:** you'll get more credits and higher-resolution output.

When you have credits again, tell me and I'll run the same edit: the bottle and cap in matte forest green, with the same shape and position. The table, shadow, background and lighting won't change.
